circuit.name: Push Pull DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated DC-DC converter using a center-tapped transformer driven by two alternating switches. Converts 12V input to 6V isolated output with output inductor filtering.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 0V to 12V output. Push-pull converter is NON-INVERTING (output positive terminal [RLOAD, pos] referenced to isolated ground [T1, CT_S]). Measure VOUT at [RLOAD, pos]. Verify output reaches target voltage with acceptable overshoot and settling time.

environment.description: 15ms simulation for startup settling (1500+ switching periods at typical 100kHz)

measurement.description: Output voltage at load (isolated secondary side)

data.name: t_settle
data.description: Time when output settles within 5% band (last crossing)

requirements.requirement: Steady-state output voltage regulation at nominal load. Measure VOUT at [RLOAD, pos] after startup transient settles. Verify output voltage is within regulation tolerance.

data.name: vout_avg
data.description: Average output voltage during steady state

requirements.requirement: Output voltage ripple at steady state. Measure peak-to-peak ripple voltage at [RLOAD, pos] during steady-state operation (after startup settling). Verify ripple is within acceptable limits.

environment.description: 15ms simulation to capture ripple after settling

data.name: vout_avg_ripple
data.description: Average output voltage for ripple percentage calculation

outputs.description: Output ripple as percentage of average voltage

requirements.requirement: Primary switch voltage and current stress. Measure peak drain-source voltage across Q1 and Q2, and peak drain current through Q1 and Q2. Verify switches operate within safe limits (no excessive voltage spikes or current overshoot).

outputs.description: Maximum Q1 drain-source voltage in volts
Maximum Q2 drain-source voltage in volts
Maximum Q1 drain current in amperes
Maximum Q2 drain current in amperes

requirements.requirement: Transformer primary and secondary current waveforms. Measure primary current (through Q1/Q2 drains) and secondary current (through D1/D2 anodes). Verify balanced operation and no DC bias buildup in transformer.

outputs.description: DC bias current in primary winding (amperes)

requirements.requirement: Output inductor current ripple and average value. Measure current through L1 ([L1, pin1] to [L1, pin2]). Verify inductor operates in continuous conduction mode (CCM) with acceptable ripple.
Secondary rectifier diode voltage and current stress. Measure peak reverse voltage across D1 and D2, and peak forward current through D1 and D2. Verify diodes operate within safe limits.

outputs.description: Maximum D1 reverse voltage in volts
Maximum D2 reverse voltage in volts
Maximum D1 forward current in amperes
Maximum D2 forward current in amperes

requirements.requirement: Converter efficiency at nominal load. Measure input power (VIN * IIN) and output power (VOUT * IOUT). Calculate efficiency as Pout/Pin. Verify efficiency meets target.
